snippet.title: PIXEL LINKS: a new look, a Classic climb that never ends, and Challenge mode
snippet.description:
PIXEL LINKS is a calm connect-the-dots puzzle in a 16-bit retro pixel world. One rule: connect every pair, don't cross the lines.

CLASSIC: one numbered climb that never ends. It adjusts to how you play.
CHALLENGE: chapter 1 has 8 stages, each with its own rule.
DAILY: one new board every day, the same for everyone. Hit a line, a dot or a crate and all your lines go. Draw again.
LINE STYLES: earned by playing, never sold.

Real gameplay from the game. Free on Google Play (with ads).
